verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows Speechmatics offering a way to operate the product itself through natural-language commands, such as a conversational assistant or a prompt-driven admin or job interface. Agent STT, the voice-agent builder and llms.txt are capabilities for building or documenting things, not natural-language operation of the product. Speech transcription is not the same as issuing commands, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
